segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I saw your note about adding the support team to the workspace. Are we still talking 18 additional seats for a March 4 go-live?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right, 18 seats. We have 42 today, so 60 total. I need the order to show the new cost starting March 1, not backdated to February.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, understood. The pricing sheet has that at $74 per seat per month on your current annual term, so the add-on is $1,332 monthly, prorated through your September 30 renewal date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance will ask if the invoice can stay quarterly. Our AP team doesn't want a separate monthly invoice for just the add-on.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. The billing tool will keep it on the same quarterly invoice. Your next invoice on April 1 would include March through June for those 18 seats, so $5,328 for the add-on portion.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can you also confirm the admin training? We have two supervisors who need to know how to manage queues before launch.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so onboarding has you booked for a 60-minute admin session on February 27 at 1 p.m. Eastern, and then a user walkthrough on March 3. I included both dates on the order notes so the implementation team has it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Legal already approved the master agreement, so this should just be the seat addendum, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, just a one-page addendum tied to the existing terms. No changes to the term length, data terms, or support level. I'll send it for e-signature today, and it routes to you and then Marcus in finance.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If Marcus signs by Friday, are we safe for March 4?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If it's signed by February 23, we'll have the seats provisioned on February 26, which gives your supervisors a week to set up groups and test logins.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Send it over, and I'll give Marcus the heads-up.
